name: Imitate Email Free
free_limit: Hosted fake SMTP email-testing service with 15 test emails per day on an ongoing free account (provider also describes this as 450 per month).
watch_out: For development and testing, not production email delivery. Free web widget is branded; team features, longer retention and additional capacity require paid plans. Verify account-specific mailbox, forwarding and commercial-use conditions before relying on them.
